verdict.rationale: For a coding agent, the user's data is their indexed codebase, and Devin produces AI insights from it inside the product. Ask Devin answers questions about code structure and dependencies and helps scope work. DeepWiki auto-generates architecture documentation, the CLI can suggest features from the code, and Devin Review gives automated PR findings. Missing for 10: insights over non-code data (e.g. databases or business metrics) are unevidenced, and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration of insight quality.
